data.narrative:
Hexana is a Seed-stage nuclear energy company founded by Sylvain Nizou and Paul Gauthe, having raised €25M to date. The valuation universe comprises 11 peers across the nuclear sector: 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms including Nano Nuclear Energy, Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, and Fuse Energy.

Stage-progression analysis was the primary applicable method, using the €25M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A advancement. This approach yielded an implied valuation of €62M. Peer-median analysis was not viable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow nuclear energy cohort—while 5 same-sector peers exist, fewer than 3 met the filtering criteria for statistical reliability, making an all-sector median unreliable.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of €53M (low) to €72M (high), with a median of €62M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single method rather than methodological diversity. Key uncertainties include: (1) the appropriateness of the 2.5x multiplier for this specific subsector, given limited Seed-stage nuclear comps; (2) exchange rate risk on the €25M base; and (3) the absence of revenue or growth-rate data to weight the valuation against operational progress. Additional financial or operational metrics would strengthen confidence in this range.
